Heard learned counsel for the appellant, learned counsel for the respondent no.2 and learned A.G.A. for the State.
2.

The instant appeal has been filed for seeking quashing of the summoning order dated 10.01.2024 passed by learned Special Judge (SC/ST Act), Auraiya in Special Session Trial No.175 of 2023,
(Seema Devi vs. Dhirendra Kumar and Others), under Sections 420, 504, 506 I.P.C. and Sections 3(1)Da, 3(1)Dha of SC/ST Act, P.S. Auraiya, District- Auraiya.

sentences.text:
4. Per contra, learned counsel for respondent no.2 as well as learned A.G.A. opposed the prayer as made in the appeal on the ground that summoning order has been passed after considering the material available on record.
5. Be that as it may, no useful purpose will be served in keeping the matter pending by way of calling counter affidavit and rejoinder affidavit by the parties and as such, learned court concerned is hereby directed to expedite and finalize the proceedings of Special Session Trial No.175 of 2023,
(Seema Devi vs. Dhirendra Kumar and Others), under Sections 420, 504, 506 I.P.C. and Sections 3(1)Da, 3(1)Dha of SC/ST Act, P.S. Auraiya, District- Auraiya, as expeditiously as possible,
preferably within a period of 12 months from the date of presentation of a certified copy of this order before him without granting any unnecessary adjournment to either of the parties.

entities.text: Seema Devi vs. Dhirendra Kumar and Others)
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 6. Learned counsel for appellant assures on behalf of the appellants that they will fully cooperate with the learned trial court concerned for expeditious disposal of the said special sessions trial.
7. However, it is made clear that till the disposal of the proceedings of the aforementioned special sessions trial, no coercive action shall be taken up against the appellant herein.

8. The instant appeal stands disposed of.
